decisions.reason: As a recently launched desk system with its own product page, substantial development effort and a strong fit with the firm's stated move toward flexible workplace interiors make management likely to continue backing it.
The chair family is close to the core offer, was given visible standalone presentation, and supports the firm's broad interior-solution strategy, so management would be inclined to stay committed.

Although somewhat more niche, the floor cushions build on the existing offer, received a dedicated page, and can be justified as part of a broader contemporary living and lounge concept, encouraging continued commitment.

Even with lower website visibility than the others, a soft upholstered sofa is central to the firm's established premium interior business, making management likely to retain it rather than reverse course after launch.
The high standing table is close to the firm's core range, publicly featured on its own page, and aligns well with flexible office and conference settings, which supports continued investment.

Despite being more distant from the traditional offer, the rug collection was visibly launched on its own page and can be defended as part of the firm's move toward complete, internationally relevant interior environments, so management would likely persist.
